test_timeout_preserves_partial_output: test LocalEnvironment.execute returns partial output and timeout notice when a command exceeds its timeout deadline
test_timeout_with_no_output: test LocalEnvironment.execute returns a clean timeout message when a command produces no output before timing out
run_terminal_command_with_timeout: run a terminal command via LocalEnvironment.execute with a specified timeout in seconds
verify_timeout_returncode: verify that a timed-out command returns exit code 124 from LocalEnvironment.execute
test_timeout_output_format: test that LocalEnvironment.execute output does not start with newline on timeout
